int root(int vertex, int[] parent)
    while parent[vertex] != vertex
        vertex = parent[vertex]
    return vertex
names := "ABCDEFGH"
edges := [
    (0, 1, 7),
    (2, 0, 4),
    (1, 2, 9),
    (1, 3, 14),
    (3, 2, 6),
    (2, 4, 3),
    (4, 3, 5),
    (5, 3, 11),
    (4, 6, 16),
    (6, 5, 8),
    (7, 5, 12),
    (6, 7, 2),
    (7, 4, 10),
]
int[] weights := []
for (_, _, weight) := edges[]
    .weights.push(weight)
edges = edges.sorted(by = weights)
parent := 0:7
accepted := 0
skipped := 0
total := 0
for (a, b, weight) := edges[]
    first := root(a, parent)
    second := root(b, parent)
    if first == second
        skipped += 1
        continue
    parent[second] = first
    println("{names[math.min(a, b)]}-{names[math.max(a, b)]} {weight}")
    total += weight
    accepted += 1
    if accepted == 7
        break
println("total weight: {total}{NL}skipped: {skipped}")
